note: The only divided capital in Europe. Split along the UN-administered Green Line since 1974; one urban fabric, two unrecognised governance zones, one open border crossing point.

name: Kinshasa
note: The only adjacent national capitals on Earth without a direct surface connection. Five kilometres of the Congo River, no bridge, no rail, ferries only; a combined twenty-million-person urban region operating as two.
